51877-the-fraud-of-feminism.title: The Fraud Of Feminism
51877-the-fraud-of-feminism.creator: E. Belfort Bax
51877-the-fraud-of-feminism.description: A book by E. Belfort Bax. course the “fatuous indulgence” for “womanhood in general,” practised by the “world at large,” is precisely one of the most conspicuous features of our time, and the person who denies it, if he is not deliberately prevaricating, must be a veritable Rip van Winkle awakening out of a sleep lasting at least two generations.

54680-peacemakers-blessed-and-otherwise-.title: Conference_
54680-peacemakers-blessed-and-otherwise-.creator: Unknown
54680-peacemakers-blessed-and-otherwise-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. from hope to despair, from an interest in the great end to an interest in the game as it is being played. My hopes and interests and irritations over the Washington Conference began weeks before it was called. All around me men and women were saying, “It will end war,” and possibly—so deep was the demand in them that war be ended—believing what they said.

70837-thrice-wedded-but-only-once-a-wife.title: But Only Once A Wife.
70837-thrice-wedded-but-only-once-a-wife.creator: Unknown
70837-thrice-wedded-but-only-once-a-wife.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The Old Homestead’ is a story of clouds and sunshine alternating over a venerated home; of a grand old man, honest and blunt, who loves his honor as he loves his life, yet suffers the agony of the condemned in learning of the deplorable conduct of a wayward son; a story of country life, love and jealousy, without an impure thought, and with the healthy flavor of the fields in every chapter. It is founded on Denman Thompson’s drama of ‘The Old Homestead.’”—_N.

arxiv-2110-01357.title: Multi-dimensional Lorenz-Based Chaotic Waveforms for Wireless Power Transfer
arxiv-2110-01357.creator: Priyadarshi Mukherjee, Member, IEEE, Constantinos Psomas, Senior Member, IEEE, and Ioannis Krikidis, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2110-01357.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate multi-dimensional chaotic signals with respect to wireless power transfer (WPT). Specifically, we analyze a multi-dimensional Lorenz-based chaotic signal under a WPT framework. By taking into account the nonlinearities of the energy harvesting process, closed-form analytical expressions for the average harvested energy are derived.

arxiv-2204-13952.title: Deep Geometry Post-Processing for Decompressed Point Clouds
arxiv-2204-13952.description: Abstract Point cloud compression plays a crucial role in reducing the huge cost of data storage and transmission. However, distortions can be introduced into the decompressed point clouds due to quantization. In this paper, we propose a novel learning-based post-processing method to enhance the decompressed point clouds. Specifically, a voxelized point cloud is first divided into small cubes.

arxiv-2210-17072.title: An inductive proof of the Bollobás two family theorem
arxiv-2210-17072.creator: Sayan Goswami
arxiv-2210-17072.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sayan Goswami. Inspired by the inductive proof of the LYM-inequality given by P. Frankl in [ 3 ] , we provide an inductive proof of the Bollobás two family theorem [ 2 ] . Keywords: Bollobas two family theorem The LYM inequality established by Lubell [ 4 ] , Yamamoto [ 7 ] and Meshalkin [ 5 ] is one of the fundamental result in combinatorics. One can find several proofs of this result in literature.

arxiv-2212-09271.title: Very Large Language Model as a Unified Methodology of Text Mining
arxiv-2212-09271.creator: Meng Jiang
arxiv-2212-09271.description: Abstract Text data mining is the process of deriving essential information from language text. Typical text mining tasks include text categorization, text clustering, topic modeling, information extraction, and text summarization. Various data sets are collected and various algorithms are designed for the different types of tasks.

arxiv-2311-14730.title: MemoryCompanion: A Smart Healthcare Solution to Empower Efficient Alzheimer’s Care Via Unleashing Generative AI These authors contributed equally
arxiv-2311-14730.creator: Lifei Zheng, Yeonie Heo, Yi Fang
arxiv-2311-14730.description: Abstract With the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), notably characterized by GPT frameworks, there emerges a catalyst for novel healthcare applications. Earlier iterations of chatbot caregivers, though existent, have yet to achieve a dimension of human-like authenticity. This paper unveils ‘MemoryCompanion’ a pioneering digital health solution explicitly tailored for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) patients and their caregivers.

arxiv-2404-07379.title: Schur rings over Sp ⁡ ( 𝐧 , 𝟐 ) {\bf{\rm Sp}(n,2)} and multiplicity one subgroups
arxiv-2404-07379.creator: Stephen Humphries
arxiv-2404-07379.description: Abstract . We study commutative Schur rings over the symplectic groups Sp ( n , 2 ) (n,2) containing the class 𝒞 \mathcal{C} of symplectic transvections. We find the possible partitions of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} determined by the Schur ring. We show how this restricts the possibilities for multiplicity one subgroups of Sp ( n , 2 ) (n,2) .

arxiv-2409-04090.title: Estimation of service value parameters for a queue with unobserved balking
arxiv-2409-04090.creator: Daniel Podorojnyi and Liron Ravner
arxiv-2409-04090.description: Abstract In Naor’s model [ 17 ] , customers decide whether or not to join a queue after observing its length. This work considers a variation in which customers are heterogeneous in their service value (reward) R R from completed service and homogeneous in the cost of staying in the system per unit of time.

arxiv-2410-18578.title: Diophantine approximation and the Mass Transference Principle: incorporating the unbounded setup
arxiv-2410-18578.creator: Bing Li, Lingmin Liao, Sanju Velani, Baowei Wang, Evgeniy Zorin
arxiv-2410-18578.description: Abstract We develop the Mass Transference Principle for rectangles of Wang & Wu (Math. Ann. 2021) to incorporate the ‘unbounded’ setup; that is, when along some direction the lower order (at infinity) of the side lengths of the rectangles under consideration is infinity.

arxiv-2601-21916.title: JADE: Bridging the Strategic-Operational Gap in Dynamic Agentic RAG
arxiv-2601-21916.creator: Yiqun Chen, Erhan Zhang, Tianyi Hu, Shijie Wang, Zixuan Yang, Meizhi Zhong, Xiaochi Wei, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Jiaxin Mao
arxiv-2601-21916.description: Abstract The evolution of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has shifted from static retrieval pipelines to dynamic, agentic workflows where a central planner orchestrates multi-turn reasoning. However, existing paradigms face a critical dichotomy: they either optimize modules jointly within rigid, fixed-graph architectures, or empower dynamic planning while treating executors as frozen, black-box tools.

pmc-10517980.title: Taguchi-TOPSIS based optimization of comfort in compression stockings for vascular disorders
pmc-10517980.creator: Muhammad Nadeem, Hafsa Jamshaid, Rajesh Mishra, Naseer Ahmed, Vijay Chandan, Petr Jirku, Viktor Kolar, Miroslav Muller
pmc-10517980.description: Compression stockings/socks are one of the most essential materials to treat vascular disorders in veins. However, the comfort of wearing such stockings over prolonged period of time is a major problem. There is limited research in the area of comfort optimization while retaining the compressional performance.

pmc-10753803.title: Synthesis of Plasmonically Active Titanium Nitride Using a Metallic Alloy Buffer Layer Strategy
pmc-10753803.creator: Arthur
pmc-10753803.description: Titanium nitride (TiN) has emerged as a highly promising alternative to traditional plasmonic materials. This study focuses on the inclusion of a Cr90Ru10 buffer layer between the substrate and thin TiN film, which enables the use of cost-effective, amorphous technical substrates while preserving high film quality.

pmc-11540282.title: Cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibition: a pathway to reducing risk of morbidity and promoting longevity
pmc-11540282.creator: Michael H Davidson, Andrew Hsieh, John JP Kastelein
pmc-11540282.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Purpose of reviewTo review the evidence and describe the biological plausibility for the benefits of inhibiting cholesteryl ester transfer protein (CETP) on multiple organ systems through modification of lipoprotein metabolism.Recent findingsResults from observational studies, Mendelian randomization analyses, and randomized clinical trials support the potential of CETP inhibition to reduce atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk through a reduction of apolipoprotein B-containing lipoproteins. In contrast, raising high-density lipoprotein (HDL) particles, as previously hypothesized, did not contribute to ASCVD risk reduction.

pmc-11616367.title: Health care costs and service utilization in the first year following moderate to severe traumatic injury
pmc-11616367.creator: Mari Storli Rasmussen, Yuan Zhang, Nada Andelic, Eline Aas
pmc-11616367.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundMost of the previous studies on costs following trauma have focused solely on in-hospital costs and costs associated with the acute treatment and early rehabilitation. As a result, post-hospital costs are often neglected in the estimation of total costs. We aimed to describe service utilization and total costs for health care services, rehabilitation services, and social support in the periods 0–6 months and 7–12 months after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury.

pmc-11713613.title: Lecanemab Slows Amyloid‐Induced Tau Pathology as Supported by CSF MTBR‐tau243 in Clarity AD
pmc-11713613.creator: Kristin R Wildsmith, Pallavi Sachdev, Kanta Horie, Larisa Reyderman, Arnaud Charil, Michio Kanekiyo, Han Yin, David Li, Akihiko Koyama, Shobha Dhadda, Michael C. Irizarry, Lynn D Kramer
pmc-11713613.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLecanemab is a humanized immunoglobulin G1 monoclonal antibody targeting neurotoxic Aβ protofibrils and Aβ plaques, which reduces markers of amyloid and significantly slows clinical decline on multiple cognition and function measures. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) microtubule‐binding region (MTBR) of tau containing the residue 243 (MTBR‐tau243) is an emerging tau pathology biomarker that tracks with tangle formation in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) [Horie et al.

pmc-12107330.title: Efficacy of Platelet-Rich Plasma and Platelet-Rich Fibrin in Enhancing Dental Implant Osseointegration
pmc-12107330.creator: Emad Taghizadeh, Sahar Negargar, Sara Noorizadeh, Seyed Mohammad Mahdi Mirmohammadi, Zahra Salmani
pmc-12107330.description: The successful integration of dental implants relies on osseointegration, a process essential for implant stability and longevity. Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) and Platelet-Rich Fibrin (PRF) have gained attention as biological enhancers for this process due to their high concentrations of growth factors that promote bone regeneration and accelerate healing.

pmc-12586085.title: Global, regional, and national burden of 34 cancer groups across 204 countries and territories, 1990–2021, and projections to 2050: a systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021
pmc-12586085.creator: Linfeng Zhu, Jiangpeng Zhu, Qing Wang, Xiaotong Sun, YuTao Yuan, Sheng Ding, Jiafeng Zhao, Lei Liu, Shuangshuang Hou
pmc-12586085.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionDetailed, comprehensive, and timely reporting on cancer incidence, mortality, and associated burdens is essential for understanding the evolving trends of this complex disease. This study aims to evaluate the burdens of 34 types of cancer across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2021, incorporating the latest epidemiological data to provide a framework for policy discussions, resource allocation, and research prioritization.MethodsUsing data from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 study, we analyzed 34 cancer types across 204 countries from 1990 to

pmc-12587617.title: Intraoperative precision of 25-gauge beveled-tip versus 23-gauge flat-tip probes in day surgery vitrectomy for proliferative diabetic retinopathy: a comparative cohort study
pmc-12587617.creator: Daxi Xue, Yanchun Zhang, Ziwei Kang, Jiamin Zheng, Yingnan He, Xin Luo
pmc-12587617.description: BackgroundTo compare the intraoperative performance and safety of the 10k cuts-per-minute (cpm)/25-gauge (G) beveled-tip probe (BTP) versus the 5k-cpm/23-G flat-tip probe (FTP) in microincision vitrectomy surgery (MIVS) for proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR).MethodsThis comparative interventional cohort study enrolled 173 eyes of 156 consecutive patients with PDR.

pmc-12652733.title: Klf5a in Endoderm Promotes Pharyngeal Cartilage Morphogenesis
pmc-12652733.creator: Wanqiu Li, Zeyao Zhu, Ou Sha, Xia Wang, Thimios A Mitsiadis
pmc-12652733.description: Pharyngeal cartilage, derived from neural crest cells (NCCs), undergoes complex morphogenesis driven by signals from the pharyngeal endoderm. However, the molecular mechanisms governing NCC proliferation and differentiation in response to endoderm-derived signals remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the role of klf5a, a zinc-finger transcription factor expressed in pharyngeal endodermal pouches, in zebrafish pharyngeal cartilage development.

pmc-12678881.title: Lysosomal acid lipase deficiency: The forgotten link between liver and cardiovascular disease
pmc-12678881.creator: Paolo Fornengo, Arianna Ferro, Sharmila Fagoonee, Elisa Rinaudo, Cristina Amione, Marilena Durazzo
pmc-12678881.description: Lysosomal acid lipase-deficiency (LAL-D) is a rare and systemic condition, secondary to lipase A gene mutations, responsible for lysosomal accumulation of cholesteryl esters and triglycerides in many tissues. It is a very heterogeneous disease in terms of the age of onset, severity, and the type of clinical and radiological manifestations.

pmc-12903529.title: KGLGANSynergy: knowledge graph-based local and global attention network for drug synergy prediction
pmc-12903529.creator: Chaokun Yan, Menglei Chu, Ge Zhang, Caili Fang, Nian Liu, Huimin Luo
pmc-12903529.description: BackgroundDrug combination therapy offers an effective strategy for treating complex diseases by leveraging synergistic multi-target effects. However, conventional experimental approaches for identifying synergistic drug pairs are costly and inefficient. Graph representation learning has shown strong potential for modeling complex biomolecular interactions and is widely applied to drug synergy prediction.

pmc-13018035.title: Environmental and chemical modulation of Staphylococcus aureus Newman biofilm formation
pmc-13018035.creator: Ahmed R Ragab, Ahmed R El‐Sheakh, Shokri M Shafik
pmc-13018035.description: AbstractStaphylococcus aureus biofilm formation enhances survival on host tissues and medical devices. This study tested how oxidative stress (H₂O₂), pH (5–9), NaCl (0–10%), and human serum (5–50%) affect the Newman strain biofilm and key genes (icaA, icaD, sarA). Biofilm was quantified by crystal violet assays and Lowry protein assay methods, and gene expression was measured by quantitative real-time PCR.

pmc-13020322.title: The interplay of night eating syndrome with resting metabolic rate, anthropometric measures, and sleep quality in normal-weight female university students: a case–control study
pmc-13020322.creator: Serkan Aslan, Saniye Sozlu, Osman Bozkurt, Ayşe Çamli, Merve Arslan-Tanis, Betul Kocaadam-Bozkurt
pmc-13020322.description: AimsNight eating syndrome (NES) is characterized by food consumption during bedtime or late night. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between NES and resting metabolic rate (RMR), anthropometric measurements, and sleep quality.MethodsThe study employed a case–control design to compare individuals with NES and healthy controls in terms of RMR, anthropometric parameters, and sleep quality.

pmc-13046595.title: Correspondance: Venetoclax combined with FLAG-based chemotherapy induces rapid and deep responses in early T-cell precursor lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. Report of two cases and review of the literature
pmc-13046595.creator: Julien Dereme, Amandine Segot, Mitja Nabergoj, Natacha Dewarrat, Valentin Basset, Sabine Blum, Gerasimos Tsilimidos
pmc-13046595.description: able prognosis in adults [1]. Unfavorable outcomes in ETP-ALL are primarily due to the lower responses after induction chemotherapy [1]. Consolidation with allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (allo-HCT) is recommended, to overcome the chemoresistance, significantly improving overall survival (OS) and aligning the prognosis with that of non-ETP-ALL [2].

pmc-13101834.title: Effects of HO-1 on the Integrity of Retinal Pigment Epithelial Cells in Regulating Axial Elongation in Experimental Myopia
pmc-13101834.creator: He-Yan Li, Yu-Hang Yang, Li Dong, Rui-Heng Zhang, Wen-Da Zhou, Hao-Tian Wu, Jiao-Yue Dong, Chu-Yao Yu, Shan-Shan Wang, Wen-Bin Wei
pmc-13101834.description: PurposeThe study aimed to explore the potential involvement of the heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) protein in myopic axial elongation. Tight junctions (TJs) form the structural basis of retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) barrier functions. Although oxidative stress contributes to myopia, it remains unclear how HO-1 influences TJ integrity in RPE cells.

pmc-13109276.title: Systematic analysis of loss-of-function variants across MODY genes demonstrates gene-specific effects and expands the spectrum of INS variants causing MODY
pmc-13109276.creator: Thomas W. Laver, Aparajita Sriram, Matthew N. Wakeling, Zeynep Şiklar, Farah Kobaisi, Oguzhan Kalyon, Andrew T. Hattersley, Michael N. Weedon, Sarah E. Flanagan, Elisa De Franco, Kevin Colclough, Kashyap A. Patel
pmc-13109276.description: Aims/hypothesisAccurate interpretation of loss-of-function (LOF) variants in MODY genes is essential for diagnosis but remains challenging, particularly for variants that are predicted to escape nonsense-mediated decay (NMD). We aimed to systematically evaluate the pathogenicity of LOF variants, stratified by NMD-triggering and NMD-escape status, across all known MODY genes.

pmc-13329827.title: Diagnosing Hyper IgE Syndrome in a Resource‐Limited Setting: A Case Report Highlighting the Utility of Clinical Scoring and Multidisciplinary Management
pmc-13329827.creator: Roshna Devi, Huda Raja, Prithvi Raj, Muhammad Hassan Ahsan, Abdullah Nadeem, Nahid Raufi
pmc-13329827.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHyperimmunoglobulin E syndrome (HIES), also known as Job’s syndrome, is an uncommon primary immunodeficiency disorder characterized by markedly elevated serum IgE levels, recurrent infections, both bacterial and fungal, and distinct skeletal and connective tissue anomalies.

pmc-13535442.title: 84 Phase 3 Study to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of 177Lu-girentuximab in Advanced, Relapsed or Recurrent ccRCC (LUTEON; NCT07197580)
pmc-13535442.creator: Sumanta Pal, Andrew Scott, Thea Faivre, David Cade
pmc-13535442.description: BackgroundA high unmet need remains for treatments that provide durable disease control while preserving quality of life in patients with advanced clear-cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). Girentuximab is a monoclonal antibody targeting CAIX, expressed on > 95% ccRCC cells (limited expression in healthy tissues). Radiolabeling girentuximab with β-emitting lutetium-177 (177Lu-girentuximab) enables targeted delivery to CAIX-expressing tumor cells.

pmc-13647846.title: Evaluation of self-efficacy and its limiting factors among children with asthma aged 8–18 years
pmc-13647846.creator: Raheleh Shanazari, Fatemeh Gholamzadeh, Mojgan Safari, Younes Mohammadi, Arash Khalili
pmc-13647846.description: Background and ObjectiveAsthma is the most prevalent chronic disease in childhood, and self-efficacy is a key determinant of symptom control, treatment adherence, and prevention of exacerbations. Despite advances in pharmacological management, many children continue to experience barriers that hinder effective self-management.
